name: Coastal Levantine
address: A stranger is addressed by trade or origin before name.
A guest is offered water and bread before business.
notes: Harbor society: scribes, shipmasters, brokers, and household workshops. Obligation is spoken aloud, not assumed.

sources: Ugaritic letters and administrative texts, general
provenance.notes: A composite of coastal Levantine harbor life; not a claim about any single town.
